_comment: Frozen M2 DR4-day-one AMRF triage config. Sources: Shahaf+19 (MNRAS 487,5610) eq.4/6; Shahaf+23 (MNRAS 518,2991) Halbwachs vetting + sigma_TI; El-Badry+26 (arXiv:2608.06453) significance/F2 discriminators; calibration in gaia-dr4/M2-amrf-triage.md.
period_note: DR4 baseline ~66 mo = 2011 d; DR3 validation used 1500 d. BH2 (P=1352 d) proves P<1000 d is too tight.
m1_policy: photometric EEM MS (CMD cut, no extinction corr)
ruwe_cut: NONE -- high RUWE is the orbit signature (BH1 7.6, BH2 9.2)
